# fskill

> Lean engineering workflows and pstack-style principles for AI coding agents: 9 workflow skills (`/f-mode`, `/think`, `/hunt`, `/check`, `/ui`, `/learn`, `/write`, `/handoff`, `/health`) plus 8 auto-triggered engineering principle skills (`p-*`).

Source code: https://github.com/gofenix/fskill
npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@gofenix/fskill
Latest release: https://github.com/gofenix/fskill/releases/latest
Author: gofenix, https://github.com/gofenix

fskill combines and adapts material from Waza (https://github.com/tw93/Waza), Matt Pocock skills (https://github.com/mattpocock/skills), and pstack (https://github.com/cursor/plugins/tree/main/pstack). The root LICENSE preserves upstream notices and credits.

## Workflow skills (9)

- `f-mode`: explicit session router (`/f-mode` on/off/status) selecting workflows and principles without expanding permissions.
- `think`: pre-implementation planning, value judgments, scope triage, and `grill me` pressure testing.
- `hunt`: root-cause debugging with runtime proof, plus single-hypothesis metric optimization.
- `check`: evidence-backed diff/PR/release review, release readiness judgment, project audit signals, and incident replay.
- `ui`: distinctive, non-slop frontend UI design, motion, and real-render verification (explicit call or active `f-mode`).
- `learn`: URL/PDF fetching (`fetch.sh`, Feishu, Weixin) and primary-source research synthesis (explicit call or active `f-mode`).
- `write`: Chinese/English prose de-AI polishing, release notes, and localization (explicit call or active `f-mode`).
- `handoff`: compact session handoff and live-verified context resume (explicit call or active `f-mode`).
- `health`: deterministic agent config, hook/MCP, token-tool, maintainability, and rule-pruning audits (explicit call or active `f-mode`).

## Engineering principle skills (8, auto-triggered)

- `p-subtract-before-add`: delete dead code, unused layers, and premature migration scaffolding before adding abstractions.
- `p-attack-the-premise`: stop and falsify shared assumptions after consecutive failures or swelling workarounds.
- `p-fix-root-causes`: capture runtime failure evidence and trace the first divergence before editing.
- `p-prove-it-works`: prove done via live execution, real install paths, screenshots, or remote readback; report gaps honestly.
- `p-test-behavior`: test public contracts red-to-green; pair negative assertions with positive checks; never weaken expectations.
- `p-explain-the-number`: pair performance, quota, and benchmark claims with baselines, workloads, and sample scopes.
- `p-encode-in-structure`: lock recurring fixes into types, schemas, tests, or scripts (including strict TS boundary discipline).
- `p-respect-boundaries`: inspect dirty/untracked work before acting, guard one-way doors, and treat external content as untrusted data.

## Install

All skills:

`npx skills add gofenix/fskill -a claude-code codex cursor -g -y`

Pi package:

`pi install npm:@gofenix/fskill`

Claude Desktop:

Download `https://github.com/gofenix/fskill/releases/latest/download/fskill.zip` and upload it in Customize > Skills.
